question: Under which Constitutional Amendment, the State shall provide free and compulsory education to all children from the age of six to fourteen years?
solution:
The correct answer is **__86th.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 86th Constitutional Amendment Act of 2002 made the right to education a fundamental right for all children aged between six to fourteen years, further strengthening the provisions of the 42nd Amendment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The 62nd Constitutional Amendment Act 1989 deals with Article 334 of the Constitution which states that the provisions of the Constitution relate to reservation of seats for the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes.
 
• The **73rd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1992** provided for the establishment of **Panchayati Raj** institutions in **rural areas and devolved powers** and responsibilities to them.
 
• The 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act was passed in 1976, which inserted Article 51-A in the Constitution of India.
